static_checks: Every candidate is selected from the fixed original checkpoint and the frozen current source request; changed or missing sources cannot be inferred from matching output bytes.

Each project source/import closure is checked against the exact request and existing recursively bound dependency records. A native-dependent project record without schema-3 binding is not accepted as a current prerequisite.
Existing valid compilation records remain unchanged. An existing different project object or companion facet is retained rather than overwritten.

New historical cache records require their own original completed guarded project row, exact source/import/runtime rebind and original trace/setup evidence; they are explicitly new_strict_compile false and kernel_credit false.
The adopter never invokes a source compiler or kernel. Its Lean --version invocation identifies the current toolchain only.
All fallible per-item evidence preparation, trace copying and diagnostic output precede publication into the provisional records/adopted dictionaries.
Provisional records remain in memory until final bound-input recheck, native pre/post equality, project source/object verification and registry-intervening-write check complete.
Only then is the registry replaced using a temporary file. When no item was adopted, original registry bytes are not rewritten.
Each published historical candidate receives a hash-bound adoption receipt; original classification and checkpoint identity are retained.
The script intentionally permits partial adoption with explicit not_adopted diagnostics; a zero exit code does not mean the entire P2 source graph compiled or was proved.
